response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), with_baseline AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS baseline FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, baseline FROM with_baseline WHERE avg_modindex > baseline) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept
